source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.11.2, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Sulfur paudon ki growth (barhotri) ke liye zaroori nutrient (ghiza) hai. Jab mitti mein sulfate kam ho jaye to sulfur wale N/P fertilizers, ya sulfur ki teh wale (sulfur-coated) fertilizers jaise sulfur-coated urea, dal kar mitti mein sulfur wapas laya jata hai. Mitti ke components (ajza) aur microbes element sulfur ko aisi shakal mein badal dete hain jo pani mein hal ho kar paudon ke kaam aaye. Gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O) bhi fertilizer ke taur par istemal hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne gypsum ka formula CaSO₄·5H₂O likha hai. Sahi formula CaSO₄·2H₂O (calcium sulphate dihydrate) hai.

blocks.prompt: Paude sulfur sirf sulfate ki shakal mein lete hain, phir bhi khet mein element sulfur kyun dala ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Mitti ke microbes element sulfur ko aahista aahista sulfate mein oxidise karte rehte hain. Is tarah sulfur-coated dane aahista aahista sulfate dete rehte hain, jaisi crop (fasal) ko zaroorat ho.

items: Sulfur paudon ka zaroori nutrient; sulfur wale N/P fertilizers, sulfur-coated urea ya gypsum (CaSO₄·2H₂O) se mitti mein wapas.
